sentences.en: We will post the announcement in all the staff lounges.
sentences.zh: 我们将在所有员工休息室张贴公告。

sentences.en: We ate a quick lunch in a coffee lounge.
sentences.zh: 我们在一家咖啡休息室快速吃了午餐。

sentences.en: Fadil and Dania spent the next days lounging around the house.
sentences.zh: 法迪尔和达尼娅在接下来的几天里在家懒洋洋地度过了时光。
